activity.notes: Eurydice I, wife of Amyntas III and mother of three Macedonian kings, is modeled through her best-attested public political phase after Amyntas's death. Elizabeth Carney identifies her as a political actor and faction leader during the 360s. ATLAS therefore uses a representative c.369–c.360 public-activity window rather than inventing a formal regency or sovereign reign.

sources.title: Eurydice and the Birth of Macedonian Power - Oxford Academic
sources.citation_text: Elizabeth Carney describes Eurydice as the first Macedonian royal woman known to play a significant public role and as an active figure at court and in international affairs.
